text:
pagerduty: 🔔 PagerDuty alert: High 5xx rate detected (service: inference-gateway). Trigger: throttle-detector v2. Incident INC-2026-114.
oncall-bot: incident created • severity: P2 • assigned to: jamie oncall • runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/5xx-throttle
jamie: acked. looking. :eyes:
priya: saw this on dashboards, spike started ~1718054200. sending graphs.
matt: link to quick metrics: https://grafana.internal/d/infra/inference?panelId=21&from=1718054100&to=1718054300
leah: customer-facing errors up ~12% in last 3m, top regions: us-west, eu-central.
jamie: ok first step: confirm if it's routing or backend. matt can you tail ingress logs for 502/504 patterns? use this filter:
```
kubectl logs -l app=inference-gateway --since=10m | egrep "(502|504)" | head -n 200
```
matt: running now. preliminary: lots of 502 with upstream reset, connection reset by peer. also seeing sudden spike in Retry-After for a particular route: /v1/generate
priya: cross-checking PD throttles: our throttle-detector rule fired because backend latency > 1500ms + 5xx rate > 8%.
oncall-bot: note: automatic fallback to model-variant "gptx-small" is enabled for this route.
jamie: toggling canary routing off for /v1/generate to reduce fanout. doing: /admin/routing disable-canary /v1/generate
leah: pinging support: any customer reports? quick check shows two customers reported degraded responses in last 10m.
matt: scaling suggestion: nodes in pool inference-backend-3 are saturated. current CPU 92%, GPU mem 89%. suggesting scale +3.
priya: is autoscale healthy? looks like horizontal autoscaler didn't kick, maybe metric scrape lag.
jamie: manual scale: kubectl scale deploy inference-backend --replicas=12 -n prod
ops-runbook: reminder from runbook: if throttle-detector fires and upstream resets present -> consider temporarily reducing ingress concurrency and enabling circuit breaker for failing upstreams.
jamie: setting route-level concurrency cap to 40 for /v1/generate via config: `route.concurrency=40`
matt: update applied. watching.
priya: PD notes: INC-2026-114 assigned to jamie, escalation policy at 10m if not acknowledged by SRE lead.
leah: customers impacted: 2 enterprise tenants (acct-98, acct-512) see 30-60s tail latencies; low volume but high severity for SLAs.
jamie: initiating short-term mitigation: enable model-variant fallback and reduce retries at edge (old clients were sending 3 retries). Pushed config: `edge.max_retries=1`.
matt: logs show 5xx rate dropping from 11.8% -> 7.2% in last 2m since scale + routing changes.
oncall-bot: incident timeline updated: mitigation actions recorded.
priya: running a synthetic check across regions. eu-central still elevated (8.9%) but trending down.
jamie: pushing a temporary traffic split: 70% -> stable pool, 30% -> fallback variant to relieve hot workers.
leah: message for customers: drafting to support to notify acct-98 and acct-512 with ETA 15-30m while we stabilize.
matt: observed occasional 504s with stacktrace pointing to kv-cache timeouts. opening a follow-up ticket for infra-redis team.
jamie: good. if 5xx <5% and latencies normalize in 15m we'll start de-escalation. keep eyes on PD and Grafana.
priya: reminder: disable any non-essential deployments to reduce noise - rolling deploys were started earlier, suspecting correlation.
jamie: checking deployments: canceling rollout on model-serving canary: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-serving-canary -n prod`
leah: support notified customers with note: "We're mitigating an elevated error rate affecting some inference requests; engineers are working on reducing errors and latency. We'll update within 30 minutes." :white_check_mark:
oncall-bot: pager duty rotation: next on-call at 1718057800 is matt.
matt: if it resurges after de-scaling, consider draining problem pool and reimaging nodes.
jamie: thanks team. continuing to monitor. set next check-in in 10m.
priya: 10m check-in: 5xx at 4.6% now, lat P50 220ms, P95 980ms. still some region flares.
matt: leaving tail logs capture running to S3: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/INC-2026-114/
leah: preparing postmortem stub: I'll capture customer impact numbers and timeline once stabilized.
jamie: de-escalating PD: will mark as mitigated if steady for 20m. keeping incident open for follow-up infra ticket.
oncall-bot: note: incident status -> mitigated candidate (manual). awaiting confirmation.
priya: one final note: root cause hypothesis: autoscaler metric lag + concurrent canary rollout caused backend overload; we'll follow up with scaling probe improvements and rollout guardrails.
jamie: agreed. handing off to matt for next-watch monitoring until 1718057800. thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
